{{Quote|Attention citizen! By Imperial directive number 10774b, you are subject to search for contraband items. If illegal goods are located on your person, you will be punished according to Imperial action directive number 121X-421c. Your cooperation in this matter is required.|A [[Mos Eisley Police Authority|Mos Eisley Police officer]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
An '''Imperial action directive 121X-421c''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] law that allowed [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] of Imperial worlds to penalize people carrying [[Smuggler/Legends|contraband]] goods.<ref name="SWG:AED" />
